evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/core.tsx:165-168 — dashboardRoutes() mounts `<Route path="/dashboard" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/manager" replace />} />`, `<Route path="/dashboard/manager" element={<ManagerDashboardPage />} />` and `<Route path="/dashboard/resident" element={<ResidentDashboardPage />} />` with NO `<ProtectedRoute>` wrapper. The inline comment (core.tsx:161-164) justifies the omission: 'the ProtectedRoute / role check on the target page handles auth + role-based fan-out.' That claim is FALSE on the reviewed tree — verified against both target pages below.

ManagerDashboardPage (frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/dashboard/pages/ManagerDashboardPage.tsx:21-48) performs NO auth check and NO redirect: it calls `useResolvedLayout('ppt/dashboard')` (:23, an authenticated api-client query) and reads `useAuth().user` only to toggle a 'customize' link for org_admin/super_admin (:24-28). There is no `isAuthenticated` guard, no `<Navigate to="/login">`, no role fan-out. ResidentDashboardPage (ResidentDashboardPage.tsx) likewise has zero auth/role logic (grep for Navigate|redirect|isAuthenticated|useAuth|requiredRoles returns NONE). App.tsx (frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/App.tsx:252-284) wraps `<AppRoutes/>` in providers + RouteErrorBoundary + Suspense but NOT in any global ProtectedRoute — auth gating in this app is strictly per-route via `<ProtectedRoute>` (used on /emergency, /settings/*, /ai-assistant, /automations/*, /dashboard/customize, etc.). So the dashboard routes are the lone authed-surface routes with the guard omitted.

Two concrete defects follow from the gap: (1) An UNAUTHENTICATED visitor navigating directly to /dashboard (or /dashboard/manager) renders the full manager dashboard shell and fires the authed `useResolvedLayout` fetch instead of being redirected to /login the way every ProtectedRoute-wrapped route is — inconsistent access control on the primary post-login landing surface. (2) The `/dashboard` -> Navigate('/dashboard/manager') redirect (core.tsx:166) sends EVERY role, including plain residents, to the MANAGER dashboard, and ManagerDashboardPage never fans a resident back to /dashboard/resident — directly contradicting the 'role-based fan-out' the comment promises. A resident typing /dashboard lands on the manager dashboard chrome.

Landable frontend-only remedy: wrap /dashboard/manager and /dashboard/resident in `<ProtectedRoute>` (matching the peer routes), and implement the role fan-out the comment claims — either redirect /dashboard based on isManagerRole(user?.role) (the SSOT in routes/shared.tsx) or have ManagerDashboardPage redirect non-manager roles to /dashboard/resident. Delete or correct the now-false comment. Verifiable via `pnpm --filter @ppt/web typecheck` + a Vitest/RTL route test (pattern already in ProtectedRoute.routing.test.tsx) asserting an unauthenticated render of /dashboard/manager redirects to /login and a resident hitting /dashboard is not shown ManagerDashboardPage. Confidence high: traced route table (no wrapper) -> both page components (no guard/fan-out) -> App.tsx (no global guard) -> ProtectedRoute is the established mechanism used by every peer route.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/core.tsx:99-101 — the Home landing page's 'Open dashboard' CTA computes its target as `navigate(user?.role === 'manager' ? '/dashboard/manager' : '/dashboard/resident')`. It hard-codes the single string 'manager' instead of the manager-equivalence check the codebase already owns.

routes/shared.tsx:36-49 defines `MANAGER_ROLES = ['manager','org_admin','super_admin','technical_manager','property_manager']` and `isManagerRole(role)`, and its doc comment (:29-35) states MANAGER_ROLES is the 'Single source of truth shared by isManagerRole (nav/inline gating) and <ProtectedRoute requiredRoles={...}> so the two cannot drift apart.' Home's `=== 'manager'` literal bypasses that SSOT. As a direct consequence, a user whose role is org_admin, super_admin, technical_manager or property_manager clicks the primary dashboard CTA on the landing page and is routed to `/dashboard/resident` (the resident dashboard) rather than the manager dashboard.

Confirmed drift, not a debatable style choice: the SAME file-neighbourhood already uses the SSOT correctly — App.tsx:127 does `const isOperator = isManagerRole(user?.role)` to gate operator-only nav links, and core.tsx:236 gates /settings/portal-webhooks with `requiredRoles={[...MANAGER_ROLES]}`. Home is the outlier that regressed to a bare literal, so privileged non-'manager' operators get the wrong dashboard from the app's most prominent entry point.

Landable frontend-only remedy: replace `user?.role === 'manager'` at core.tsx:100 with `isManagerRole(user?.role)` (import already resolvable from ../shared, as App.tsx and core.tsx:41 already import from routes/shared). Verifiable via `pnpm --filter @ppt/web typecheck` + a Vitest/RTL test rendering Home with user.role='property_manager' and asserting the CTA navigates to /dashboard/manager. Confidence high: the literal, the SSOT helper, and the correct peer usages are all objectively confirmed by static read; the misroute is deterministic for every manager-equivalent role except plain 'manager'.
